# Saving and loading reference

The persistent id component, the save data a scene and a unit are captured into, and the calls that capture, restore and write saves. For how to use it, see [Saving and loading](../modules/saving.md).

## VtPersistentId

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Save → VtPersistentId**.

A stable id that survives save and load. Put it on every unit that should be saved: the player, NPCs, resource nodes, anything scene-placed you want remembered. The id is generated when the component is added; give the player a readable one such as `player` so your code can find it.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Generated | Stable id for save files. Generated when empty; edit it for units you look up by name. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string Id { get; }` | The id. |
| `void Assign(string newId)` | Set the id from code, for units spawned at runtime. |

## VtSaveGame

Serializable class.

A whole save: every persistent unit in a scene.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Version (`version`) | `int` | 1 | Format version, for your own migrations. |
| Scene (`scene`) | `string` | Empty | Scene the save was taken in. |
| Saved At (`savedAt`) | `string` | Empty | UTC time of the save in ISO 8601, for slot pickers. |
| Units (`units`) | List of [VtUnitSaveData](#vtunitsavedata) | Empty | Every unit with a VtPersistentId at save time. |
| Has World Time (`hasWorldTime`) | `bool` | Off | On when the scene had a VtWorldClock at save time. |
| World Time (`worldTime`) | [VtWorldClockState](world-time.md#vtworldclockstate) | — | The scene clock at save time: day, time of day, speed and pause state. |
| Stashes (`stashes`) | List of [VtStashState](shared-stash.md#vtstashstate) | Empty | What every enabled shared stash held at save time. |

## VtUnitSaveData

Serializable class.

Everything the package knows about one unit, with definitions referenced by id. Produced by `VtUnitSaver.Capture`, consumed by `VtUnitSaver.Restore`, and serializable with `JsonUtility`. Empty arrays mean the unit has no such component.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Persistent Id (`persistentId`) | `string` | Empty | Id of the unit's VtPersistentId, used to find it again on load. |
| Definition Id (`definitionId`) | `string` | Empty | Id of the unit definition, checked on restore. |
| Buildable Id (`buildableId`) | `string` | Empty | Id of the buildable this unit was placed from, so a missing building can be spawned again. Empty for other units. |
| Paid From Stash Id (`paidFromStashId`) | `string` | Empty | Id of the shared stash that paid for the placed piece; empty when none did. |
| Position (`position`) | `Vector3` | (0, 0, 0) | World position of the unit. |
| Rotation (`rotation`) | `Quaternion` | — | World rotation of the unit. |
| Has Level (`hasLevel`) | `bool` | Off | On when the unit has a level component; level and xp are only used then. |
| Level (`level`) | `int` | 0 | The unit's level. |
| Xp (`xp`) | `int` | 0 | XP gathered since the last level-up. |
| Pools (`pools`) | [VtPoolSave](#vtpoolsave)[] | Empty | Current value of each resource pool. |
| Equipment (`equipment`) | [VtEquipmentSave](#vtequipmentsave)[] | Empty | Equipped items with their durability. |
| Inventory (`inventory`) | [VtItemStackSave](#vtitemstacksave)[] | Empty | Backpack stacks with their area and slot. |
| Inventory Has Slots (`inventoryHasSlots`) | `bool` | Off | On when the inventory entries carry slot positions. Off fills the bag slots in order. |
| Held Area (`heldArea`) | `string` | Empty | Area of the held slot selection; empty when nothing is selected. |
| Held Slot (`heldSlot`) | `int` | 0 | Slot of the held slot selection in the held area. |
| Wallet (`wallet`) | [VtCurrencySave](#vtcurrencysave)[] | Empty | Currency balances. |
| Buffs (`buffs`) | [VtBuffSave](#vtbuffsave)[] | Empty | Active buffs with their remaining time. |
| Quests (`quests`) | [VtQuestSave](#vtquestsave)[] | Empty | Every quest in the log: active, completed, turned in and failed. |
| Skills (`skills`) | [VtSkillSave](#vtskillsave)[] | Empty | Crafting skills with level and XP. |
| Recipes (`recipes`) | `string`[] | Empty | Ids of the learned recipes. |
| Dialogue Flags (`dialogueFlags`) | `string`[] | Empty | Dialogue flags the unit has set. |
| Vendor Stock (`vendorStock`) | [VtVendorStockSave](#vtvendorstocksave)[] | Empty | Stock lines of the unit's vendor. |
| Respawn Waiting (`respawnWaiting`) | `bool` | Off | On while the unit was dead and waiting to respawn. |
| Respawn Seconds Remaining (`respawnSecondsRemaining`) | `float` | 0 | Seconds until the unit may respawn. |
| Death Position (`deathPosition`) | `Vector3` | (0, 0, 0) | Where the unit died. |
| Has Checkpoint (`hasCheckpoint`) | `bool` | Off | On once a respawn checkpoint was set. |
| Checkpoint (`checkpoint`) | `Vector3` | (0, 0, 0) | Position of the last checkpoint. |
| Talents (`talents`) | [VtTalentSave](#vttalentsave)[] | Empty | Learned talents and their ranks. |
| Attribute Points (`attributePoints`) | [VtAttributePointSave](#vtattributepointsave)[] | Empty | Points spent in each attribute. |
| Bonus Talent Points (`bonusTalentPoints`) | `int` | 0 | Talent points granted on top of those from levels. |
| Bonus Attribute Points (`bonusAttributePoints`) | `int` | 0 | Attribute points granted on top of those from levels. |
| Ignored Players (`ignoredPlayers`) | `string`[] | Empty | Player ids on the unit's chat ignore list. |
| Hotkeys (`hotkeys`) | `string`[] | Empty | The ability id in each hotkey slot, in slot order; an empty string for an empty slot. |
| Unlocks (`unlocks`) | `string`[] | Empty | Ids of the unlocks the unit keeps for itself. |
| Hotbars (`hotbars`) | [VtHotbarSave](#vthotbarsave)[] | Empty | Every hotbar on the unit, in component order. |

## VtSaveSystem

Static class.

Saves and loads every unit that carries a `VtPersistentId`. On load, units that still exist are restored in place; placed buildings that are gone are spawned again from their buildable's prefab; anything else missing goes to your `spawnMissing` callback. The scene's `VtWorldClock`, when there is one, and every enabled `VtSharedStash` are saved and restored with the units. Pair it with `VtSaveFile` to get JSON on disk.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static VtSaveGame Capture(string sceneName = null)` | Snapshot every registered unit that has a `VtPersistentId`. |
| `static int Restore(VtSaveGame save, VtDefinitionCatalog catalog = null, Func<VtUnitSaveData, VtUnit> spawnMissing = null)` | Restore `save` into the current scene. Returns how many units were restored. |

## VtUnitSaver

Static class.

Captures one unit into `VtUnitSaveData` and restores it. Every optional component is included when present: pools, level, equipment, backpack, wallet, buffs, quest log, crafting skills and recipe book. Definitions are stored by id and resolved through the `VtDefinitionCatalog` on restore.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static VtUnitSaveData Capture(VtUnit unit)` | Snapshot `unit`. |
| `static void Restore(VtUnit unit, VtUnitSaveData data, VtDefinitionCatalog catalog = null, bool includeTransform = true)` | Write `data` into `unit`. Components the unit lacks are skipped; ids the catalog cannot resolve are skipped with a warning. Pass `includeTransform` false to leave position and rotation alone, for example when the snapshot replicates state to a client that moves itself. |

## VtSaveFile

Static class.

JSON on disk for `VtSaveGame`, under the platform's persistent data path.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static string PathFor(string slot)` | Path of a named slot: `<persistentDataPath>/<slot>.json`. |
| `static string ToJson(VtSaveGame save)` | Serialize `save` to JSON. |
| `static VtSaveGame FromJson(string json)` | Deserialize a save from JSON. Null for empty input. |
| `static void Write(string path, VtSaveGame save)` | Write `save` to `path`, creating folders as needed. |
| `static VtSaveGame Read(string path)` | Read a save from `path`. Null when the file does not exist. |
| `static bool Exists(string path)` | True when a file exists at `path`. |
| `static void Delete(string path)` | Delete the file at `path` if it exists. |

## Enums

### VtResourceKind

The kind of a resource pool on a unit, such as health, mana, stamina or rage. A unit definition lists the pools it has; read one with `VtUnitStats.GetPool`.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `HP` | Health. The unit dies when it reaches 0. |
| `MP` | Mana, spent by spells. |
| `Stamina` | Stamina, spent by physical actions such as sprinting or dodging. |
| `Rage` | Rage, built by dealing and taking damage rather than regenerating. |
| `Focus` | Focus, a small fast-refilling pool for ranged or precise actions. |
| `Energy` | Energy, a fixed-size pool that refills quickly. |
| `ComboPoints` | Combo points, built by some abilities and spent by finishers. |
| `Charges` | Charges, discrete uses that refill one at a time. |
| `Hunger` | Food pool: decreases over time, damages HP when empty. |
| `Thirst` | Water pool: decreases over time, damages HP when empty. |
| `Shield` | Secondary HP layer — sci-fi / mage-barrier style. Regenerates out of combat (per the configured `VtRegenMode`); takes damage before HP only when consumer code wires that interception (typically via an `VtUnitStats.OnPreTakeDamage` hook). Pair with `stat.max_shield` / `stat.shield_regen`. |

### VtEquipmentSlot

The set of equipment slots an item can occupy on a unit. Used as the key for the slot map on `VtUnitEquipment` and as the source-id suffix when equipped items push their modifiers / attributes / traits (`"equipment_<slot>"`).

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | Inventory-only / non-equippable. Potions, materials, quest items. |
| `Head` | Helm / hat / hood. |
| `Chest` | Chestpiece / robe / breastplate. |
| `Legs` | Leg armor / pants / greaves. |
| `Feet` | Boots / sandals / sabatons. |
| `Hands` | Gloves / gauntlets / bracers. |
| `MainHand` | Primary weapon. 2H weapons occupy this slot and block `OffHand`. |
| `OffHand` | Off-hand weapon, shield, or focus. Auto-unequipped when a 2H is equipped to `MainHand`. |
| `Neck` | Necklace / amulet / pendant. |
| `Ring1` | First ring slot. Members of the Ring family. |
| `Ring2` | Second ring slot. Members of the Ring family. |
| `Trinket1` | First trinket slot. Members of the Trinket family. |
| `Trinket2` | Second trinket slot. Members of the Trinket family. |
| `Back` | Worn on the back: backpack, cloak, quiver. |

### VtQuestState

Lifecycle state of a single quest in a `VtUnitQuestLog`.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Available` | Not in the log and every prerequisite is met. Computed only. |
| `Active` | Accepted; objectives in progress. |
| `Complete` | Every objective satisfied; rewards not yet granted. |
| `TurnedIn` | Rewards granted. Counts for prerequisites; repeatable quests can be accepted again from here. |
| `Failed` | Time ran out or a fail condition triggered. Can be accepted again. |
